description: Mitchell's Fruit Farms Limited is a Pakistani food company whose brand dates from 1933 and now carries more than 100 products on shelves. Its history runs through preserved foods — the business grew with wartime demand for them and with the founding of Kissan Fruit Products in Bangalore — and CCL Holding's acquisition of the company later opened a new chapter in its development.
